title: HELIX Terminology: Data Classification
description: Standard data classification tiers used in the HELIX meta block. Part of HELIX Govern.

codes.definition: Data approved for unrestricted public access (e.g., course catalog, institution name)
Data intended for institutional use only (e.g., enrollment counts, section capacity)
Data protected by regulation or policy (e.g., student PII, grades, financial aid). FERPA-protected data falls here at minimum.
Highly sensitive data requiring strict access controls (e.g., SSN, health records, disciplinary records)
